name: Morning brief
prompt: Morning brief for <name>, <zone>. Write ~/briefs/<today YYYY-MM-DD>.md, where the date is today in <zone> (TZ=<zone> date +%F). Include the date; one line of weather for <city> from https://wttr.in/<city>?format=3; one short item with a link for each of: <thing 1>; <thing 2>; <thing 3>; and one sentence on what you will watch tomorrow. Use web_search. Under 200 words. If a lookup fails, say so in one line and continue. Write the file even if some lookups fail. Do not re-implement the sender: as your last step run `sudo -n /usr/bin/python3 ~/.hermes/scripts/send_brief.py` and report its one line.
